verses.text: For the choirmaster, to be accompanied by flutes. A Psalm of David. Give ear to my words, O LORD; consider my groaning.

xrefs.text: And this is the confidence that we have before Him: If we ask anything according to His will, He hears us.
Hear my prayer, O God; listen to the words of my mouth.
May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be pleasing in Your sight, O LORD, my Rock and my Redeemer.
For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and His ears are inclined to their prayer. But the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”
For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Maskil of David. Listen to my prayer, O God, and do not ignore my plea.

verses.text: Attend to the sound of my cry, my King and my God, for to You I pray.

xrefs.text: O You who listen to prayer, all people will come to You.
To the LORD I cry aloud, and He answers me from His holy mountain. Selah
A Psalm of praise. Of David. I will exalt You, my God and King; I will bless Your name forever and ever.
For the LORD is our Judge, the LORD is our lawgiver, the LORD is our King. It is He who will save us.
Even the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she places her young near Your altars, O LORD of Hosts, my King and my God.

verses.text: In the morning, O LORD, You hear my voice; at daybreak I lay my plea before You and wait in expectation.

xrefs.text: I rise before dawn and cry for help; in Your word I have put my hope.
But to You, O LORD, I cry for help; in the morning my prayer comes before You.
Early in the morning, while it was still dark, Jesus got up and went out to a solitary place to pray.
My soul waits for the Lord more than watchmen wait for the morning— more than watchmen wait for the morning.
Morning, noon, and night, I cry out in distress, and He hears my voice.

verses.text: For You are not a God who delights in wickedness; no evil can dwell with You.

xrefs.text: The LORD tests the righteous and the wicked; His soul hates the lover of violence.
Pursue peace with everyone, as well as holiness, without which no one will see the Lord.

You have wearied the LORD with your words; yet you ask, “How have we wearied Him?” By saying, “All who do evil are good in the sight of the LORD, and in them He delights,” or, “Where is the God of justice?”
But nothing unclean will ever enter it, nor anyone who practices an abomination or a lie, but only those whose names are written in the Lamb’s Book of Life.
You have done these things, and I kept silent; you thought I was just like you. But now I rebuke you and accuse you to your face.

verses.text: The boastful cannot stand in Your presence; You hate all workers of iniquity.

xrefs.text: The LORD tests the righteous and the wicked; His soul hates the lover of violence.
Therefore the wicked will not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the assembly of the righteous.
All their evil appears at Gilgal, for there I hated them. I will drive them from My house for the wickedness of their deeds. I will no longer love them; all their leaders are rebellious.
There are six things that the LORD hates, seven that are detestable to Him:
Then He will say to those on His left, ‘Depart from Me, you who are cursed, into the eternal fire prepared for the devil and his angels.

verses.text: You destroy those who tell lies; the LORD abhors the man of bloodshed and deceit.

xrefs.text: But to the cowardly and unbelieving and abominable and murderers and sexually immoral and sorcerers and idolaters and all liars, their place will be in the lake that burns with fire and sulfur. This is the second death.
But You, O God, will bring them down to the Pit of destruction; men of bloodshed and deceit will not live out half their days. But I will trust in You.
For behold, the LORD is coming out of His dwelling to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity. The earth will reveal her bloodshed and will no longer conceal her slain.
But outside are the dogs, the sorcerers, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idolaters, and everyone who loves and practices falsehood.
How long, O men, will my honor be maligned? How long will you love vanity and seek after lies Selah

verses.text: But I will enter Your house by the abundance of Your loving devotion; in reverence I will bow down toward Your holy temple.

xrefs.text: Let us go to His dwelling place; let us worship at His footstool.
I bow down toward Your holy temple and give thanks to Your name for Your loving devotion and Your faithfulness; You have exalted Your name and Your word above all else.
Let us then approach the throne of grace with confidence, so that we may receive mercy and find grace to help us in our time of need.
But my prayer to You, O LORD, is for a time of favor. In Your abundant loving devotion, O God, answer me with Your sure salvation.
Let the wicked man forsake his way and the unrighteous man his thoughts; let him return to the LORD, that He may have compassion, and to our God, for He will freely pardon.

verses.text: Lead me, O LORD, in Your righteousness because of my enemies; make straight Your way before me.

xrefs.text: Teach me Your way, O LORD, and lead me on a level path, because of my oppressors.
Show me Your ways, O LORD; teach me Your paths.
Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and lean not on your own understanding;
Teach me Your way, O LORD, that I may walk in Your truth. Give me an undivided heart, that I may fear Your name.
With all my heart I have sought You; do not let me stray from Your commandments.

verses.text: For not a word they speak can be trusted; destruction lies within them. Their throats are open graves; their tongues practice deceit.

xrefs.text: “They bend their tongues like bows; lies prevail over truth in the land. For they proceed from evil to evil, and they do not take Me into account,” declares the LORD.
“Their throats are open graves; their tongues practice deceit.” “The venom of vipers is on their lips.”
They fully intend to cast him down from his lofty perch; they delight in lies; with their mouths they bless, but inwardly they curse. Selah
For the wealthy of the city are full of violence, and its residents speak lies; their tongues are deceitful in their mouths.
A man who flatters his neighbor spreads a net for his feet.

verses.text: Declare them guilty, O God; let them fall by their own devices. Drive them out for their many transgressions, for they have rebelled against You.

xrefs.text: But they rebelled and grieved His Holy Spirit. So He turned and became their enemy, and He Himself fought against them.
May the heads of those who surround me be covered in the trouble their lips have caused.

Then Absalom and all the men of Israel said, “The advice of Hushai the Archite is better than that of Ahithophel.” For the LORD had purposed to thwart the good counsel of Ahithophel in order to bring disaster on Absalom.
Now someone told David: “Ahithophel is among the conspirators with Absalom.” So David pleaded, “O LORD, please turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness!”
For the wisdom of this world is foolishness in God’s sight. As it is written: “He catches the wise in their craftiness.”

verses.text: But let all who take refuge in You rejoice; let them ever shout for joy. May You shelter them, that those who love Your name may rejoice in You.

xrefs.text: And we know that God works all things together for the good of those who love Him, who are called according to His purpose.
After this I heard a sound like the roar of a great multitude in heaven, shouting: “Hallelujah! Salvation and glory and power belong to our God!
But the righteous will be glad and rejoice before God; they will celebrate with joy.
May all who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; may those who love Your salvation always say, “The LORD be magnified!”
Rather, as it is written: “No eye has seen, no ear has heard, no heart has imagined, what God has prepared for those who love Him.”

verses.text: For surely You, O LORD, bless the righteous; You surround them with the shield of Your favor.

xrefs.text: For the LORD God is a sun and a shield; the LORD gives grace and glory; He withholds no good thing from those who walk with integrity.
Many are the sorrows of the wicked, but loving devotion surrounds him who trusts in the LORD.
He will bless those who fear the LORD— small and great alike.
Blessed is the man who does not walk in the counsel of the wicked, or set foot on the path of sinners, or sit in the seat of mockers.
Hallelujah! Blessed is the man who fears the LORD, who greatly delights in His commandments.
